scope: 20 named baselines in manuscript Tables 1 and 2; numerical entries and Appendix A are unchanged
author_confirmation: The authors confirmed that the manuscript baseline results were rerun and checked with seeds 7, 50 and 81. Public benchmark CSVs are independent cross-check references, not the run archive of these experiments.
version_boundary: Audited upstream commits identify inspectable code, not necessarily the historical versions used for author reruns or the TimeMixer++ source tables.
seed_boundary: An upstream default, iteration counter, fold identifier or diffusion sample count is not a recovered seed-to-result ledger for the author reruns.

methods.upstream_seed_protocol: No independently identifiable TimeMixer++ entry point at the paper-linked repository snapshot; no numeric seed list recovered for TimeMixer++.
methods.upstream_repetition_protocol: Paper Appendices A/G state three repetitions. This does not identify individual seeds or establish the protocol of every inherited baseline row.
methods.interpretation: The paper-linked repository implements TimeMixer. Its fixed seed 2021 must not be assigned to TimeMixer++ or treated as the code that generated the reported TimeMixer++ reruns. Only the public benchmark tables were available for independent numerical cross-checking of TimeMixer++; the author-side adapted implementation/run ledger was not supplied to this audit.
